attributes.langfuse.observation.input: How much bereavement leave is there?

In more detail: Annual leave, sick leave and public holidays Annual leave Full-time employees receive **28 days** of paid annual leave per calendar year, pro-rated for part-time and for joiners. Up to **5 unused days** carry over to the next year and must be used by 31 March. Request leave in Workday at least two weeks ahead for periods over three days; your manager approves within five working days. Sick leave Notify your manager before your usual start time on day one. From the **4th consecutive day** a doctor's note is required (Source: Annual leave, sick leave and public holidays). Next step: submit the request in Workday; your manager approves within five working days.
